common.title: Member State Defection
common.line: A member state cuts its own arrangement – with a hyperscaler, with Washington, or with Beijing – on terms that undercut a position the Union has taken.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Manual reversion lockin
notable.line: Municipal utilities and hospital operators quietly abandon metered US fallback and revert to manual paper procedures after vandalism and quota cuts, entrenching a low-tech equilibrium that persists beyond the incident.

notable.title: Quota grey market exposure
notable.line: A grey brokerage network reselling US-quota chips and cloud inference into EU hospitals and labs via third-country intermediaries is exposed, forcing seizures and sudden service losses.

notable.title: Shadow maintenance pact
notable.line: Municipal utilities and hospital technicians formalize an off-books spares-and-repair network, cannibalizing decommissioned equipment to keep non-showcase sites running despite the two-tier shield.
